tool.title: Renewals
tool.about: A template tool from the design library. It tracks when contracts renew, from the documents they came from. Copy it to start a new tool.

overview.title: Renewals
overview.sub: {total, plural, one {# contract renews} other {# contracts renew}} before {date}. {decide, plural, =0 {None need a decision.} one {# needs a decision.} other {# need a decision.}}
overview.needsDecisionEmpty: Nothing needs a decision this quarter.
overview.noticeIn: {days, plural, =0 {Notice due today} one {Notice due tomorrow} other {Notice due in # days}}
overview.emptyBody: Add a contract and the date it renews. Its owner hears about it before the notice date, with the clause that says so.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.sub: {count, plural, one {# contract} other {# contracts}} from {sources, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}

contract.noticeHowValue: In writing, to the address in the contract
contract.notFoundTitle: This contract is no longer here
contract.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
contract.decisionBody: {vendor} renews on {date}. Say what happens next; the owner is told.
contract.historyBody: Everything that has happened to this renewal.
contract.deleteBody: {vendor} stops being tracked and nobody is reminded. The contract document stays where it is.
contract.askQuestion: When does {vendor} renew, and what does the contract say about giving notice?

create.title: New renewal
create.sub: Track a contract so its owner hears before the notice date.
create.sourceHint: The clause about renewal is quoted from this document.
create.valueHint: In US dollars. Leave it empty if you don't know.
create.remind: Remind the owner 30 days before the notice date

settings.title: Settings
settings.remindersBody: Owners hear about a renewal before its notice date.
settings.leadBody: Counted back from the notice date, not the renewal date.
settings.digestBody: A Monday message to each owner listing what renews in the next 90 days.
settings.offNotice: Reminders are off. Owners won't hear about notice dates until you turn them back on.
settings.dangerBody: Stops tracking all contracts in this workspace. The documents stay.
settings.dangerConfirmBody: All {count, plural, one {# contract stops} other {# contracts stop}} being tracked. This can't be undone.
